fields.name: site
fields.label: Site

options.notes: useEnvData requests /v1/parameter/location?location_type=Site&location_type=Module (ui/src/hooks/useEnvData.ts:34-41); the repeated location_type key is an array, which v1 OptionSource.params (scalar values only) cannot express. Rows are mapped by mapLocationOptions (ui/src/lib/location-options.ts:25-36): label = name, value = 'dcim-location:' + JSON [location_type, id] when the row has a location_type, otherwise the bare id. The encoded value is UI-only and is decoded back to id + location_type before use (ui/src/lib/location-options.ts:39-59).

fields.query_param_normalization: Used verbatim as the initial value (searchParams.get('site'), ui/src/app/workflows/devicepasswordrotationworkflow/form/device-password-rotation-form.tsx:54) and never resolved to an option value. A site name in the URL therefore selects nothing, while useDevices treats the raw string as a bare provider id with no site_type (ui/src/hooks/useDevices.ts:43-50).
client_only_validation: Changing site clears device and selected_secret (ui/src/app/workflows/devicepasswordrotationworkflow/form/device-password-rotation-form.tsx:83-89, 124-128).
Submit disabled until site is set (ui/src/app/workflows/devicepasswordrotationworkflow/form/device-password-rotation-form.tsx:186).
fields.submit_transform: Not submitted. UI-only filter feeding the device option request.

fields.name: device_id
fields.label: Device
fields.schema_description: Identifier of the network device to update.

options.notes: ui/src/app/workflows/devicepasswordrotationworkflow/form/device-password-rotation-form.tsx:64-73 passes [['site', site], ['managed_only', 'true']]; useDevices strips site and re-appends the decoded site=<id> and site_type=<location_type> (ui/src/hooks/useDevices.ts:43-51), giving managed_only=true&site=<id>[&site_type=<type>]. No tenant/status filters. Not fetched while site is empty (ui/src/hooks/useDevices.ts:53-56). site is a UI-only form field. Rows map to {key: name, value: id, platform} (ui/src/hooks/useDevices.ts:59-61).

fields.query_param_normalization: Single value from searchParams.get('device') (ui/src/app/workflows/devicepasswordrotationworkflow/form/device-password-rotation-form.tsx:55). The param is 'device', not 'device-id' as in DeviceWorkflowForm and Nautobot. It is not checked against options, and the site effect clears it on mount whenever site is also present (ui/src/app/workflows/devicepasswordrotationworkflow/form/device-password-rotation-form.tsx:83-89), so the prefill only survives when site is absent, in which case the field is disabled.
client_only_validation: Disabled until a site is selected (ui/src/app/workflows/devicepasswordrotationworkflow/form/device-password-rotation-form.tsx:165).
Submit disabled until device is set (ui/src/app/workflows/devicepasswordrotationworkflow/form/device-password-rotation-form.tsx:186).

fields.name: selected_secret
fields.label: Secret to Rotate
fields.schema_description: Name of the managed secret containing the replacement password.

options.notes: useSWR on `${workflowApiUrl}/v1/parameter/device/${device}/password_users` (ui/src/app/workflows/devicepasswordrotationworkflow/form/device-password-rotation-form.tsx:76-80). The device id is a path segment, not a query parameter. Rows {name, description} map to key = name, value = name (ui/src/app/workflows/devicepasswordrotationworkflow/form/device-password-rotation-form.tsx:130-137), so the description '<username> (<secret name>)' is discarded. The server returns 400 when the device has no password mappings and hides svc-ngc-cfa-nv-config-manager (src/nv_config_manager/temporal/api/parameter_v1.py:409-437). Not fetched until a device is selected.

fields.query_param_normalization: Initial value from searchParams.get('selected_secret') (ui/src/app/workflows/devicepasswordrotationworkflow/form/device-password-rotation-form.tsx:56). It is cleared on mount whenever a device is set (ui/src/app/workflows/devicepasswordrotationworkflow/form/device-password-rotation-form.tsx:92-96), and device is itself cleared when site is set, so the prefill has no effect in practice.
client_only_validation: Disabled until a device is selected (ui/src/app/workflows/devicepasswordrotationworkflow/form/device-password-rotation-form.tsx:179).
Submit button disabled unless site, device and selected_secret are all set (ui/src/app/workflows/devicepasswordrotationworkflow/form/device-password-rotation-form.tsx:186).

payload_transform: onSubmit (ui/src/app/workflows/devicepasswordrotationworkflow/form/device-password-rotation-form.tsx:98-122) builds {device_id: data.device, selected_secret: data.selected_secret} in that key order and awaits startWorkflow('/v1/workflow/ngc/device_password_rotation') (ui/src/lib/utils.tsx:153-184), which navigates to /workflows/{id}. After it resolves, the form shows a success toast and calls form.reset(). Errors produce a destructive toast. isSubmitting is reset in finally. devicePasswordRotationForm.spec.ts:68-71 asserts the exact body.
discrepancies: URL prefill for device and selected_secret is effectively dead: on mount the site effect clears both and the device effect clears selected_secret. Site prefill is not resolved to an encoded option value.
The device query param is 'device'. DeviceWorkflowForm and every Nautobot link use 'device-id'.

The schema describes selected_secret as the 'Name of the managed secret', but the UI submits the password user name (Secret.name = username, src/nv_config_manager/temporal/api/parameter_v1.py:430-436) and the workflow uses it as username (packages/workflows/src/nv_config_manager_workflows/workflows/device_password_rotation.py:361).
Only NVCM-managed devices (managed_only=true) can be chosen. The schema has no such restriction.
The Submit button is disabled until all three fields are set. Schema/Ajv validation would report these as missing-field errors instead.
No Nautobot link and no URL-prefill Playwright coverage.
contract_gaps: The selected_secret options endpoint carries the dependency in the path (/v1/parameter/device/{device_id}/password_users). v1 OptionSource.endpoint is a fixed path and depends_on can only add query parameters.
site is a UI-only filter with no model field, so it cannot carry a UiHint. It would have to be embedded in a device_reference widget.

Disabling a field until its dependency is set (device until site, secret until device) has no v1 equivalent. visible_if {field: device_id, op: not_equals, value: ""} could approximate it for selected_secret by hiding instead of disabling, but nothing can express it for the UI-only site.
Changing site or device clears the dependent fields. v1 has no clear-on-dependency-change flag.
OptionSource.params is scalar-only (location_type=Site&location_type=Module), and the location value is a UI-encoded composite decoded into site + site_type for /v1/parameter/device.
